caption:
Meet Momo - the little robot who lives on my desktop and quietly gets my workday done. One tap, one sentence: emails drafted (never sent without my yes), meetings booked, notes taken in Hindi or English, to-dos ticked, and yesterday she built my whole VCP presentation straight from the Excel. Everything stays on my laptop.

#Momo #DesktopAgent #AIAssistant #ClaudeCode #VoiceAssistant #Productivity #WorkSmarter #BuildInPublic #AIAgents #Philips

scenes.heading: Meet Momo.
scenes.sub: the little robot who lives on my desktop
scenes.narration: Meet Momo. She lives in the corner of my screen, and quietly gets my day done.

scenes.label: Sound familiar?
scenes.narration: Forty emails, three meetings, a to-do list I keep forgetting. Sound familiar?

scenes.heading: One tap. She handles it.
cards: Drafts my emails, asks before sending
Books Teams meetings around my calendar
Takes notes in Hindi, English or Hinglish
Keeps my to-dos ticked in OneNote
scenes.narration: One tap, and I just talk. She drafts my emails, books my meetings, takes notes in Hindi or English, and keeps my to-dos ticked.

scenes.label: My favourite part
scenes.narration: Yesterday I said: take the excel and make me the presentation. Half a minute later it was open in PowerPoint. Every number exact.

scenes.label: Private by design
scenes.narration: Everything stays on my laptop. Nothing is ever sent without my yes.

scenes.heading: Everyone deserves a Momo.
scenes.handle: Follow for what she learns next
scenes.narration: Everyone deserves a Momo. Follow along, and I'll show you what she learns next.
